statement: Where a capability's circuit comes from. The circuit is a view of the selected database authority, derived on demand by the estate service through the same `capability circuit` operation invocation uses. The database is the only source; no separately compiled topology product participates and there is no fallback.

resolver.servedBy: sfx-platform, app/workbench/scene/[capabilityId]/[viewId]/route.ts, which calls the estate service's `capability circuit` operation, derived by sfx-embody src/derive-circuit.mjs
resolver.note: The response is the derived circuit-scene.v1 document. The capability is selected by identity; the service reads the current authority at request time, so the circuit always reflects the selected snapshot.

rationale: the browser receives a resolved scene rather than authority it would have to interpret
the circuit is derived from the same authority invocation reads, so the circuit and the executed body agree by construction
nothing outside the database participates in the runtime lifecycle

parity.with: sfx-embody src/derive-circuit.mjs, exposed as the `capability circuit` operation

governance.note: Deriving a circuit reads selected authority. It is not registered estate authority and confers no admission.

refusalCodes.SCENE_IDENTITY_INVALID: The capability or view identity is not the shape the compiler emits.
refusalCodes.VIEW_IDENTITY_MISMATCH: The derived scene declares a different view.
refusalCodes.SCENE_REFUSED: The scene carried error findings, so neither its graph nor its bytes are served.
refusalCodes.SCENE_UNAVAILABLE: No circuit could be derived, or the estate service was unavailable.
